description: Multiplayer-native quest database tables derived from content imports. ESM and ESP files are import sources only; the server owns runtime quest state.

packages.purpose: Imported content package metadata and dependency hints.

quest_definitions.purpose: Server-owned quest definitions with multiplayer scope, sharing, repeat, and instancing policies.

quest_steps.purpose: Ordered quest progress nodes. Source journal indexes are preserved but are not the runtime authority.

dialogue_topics.purpose: Topics, greetings, persuasion, and voice sources that may unlock or advance quests.

dialogue_responses.purpose: Server-filtered response candidates linked to topics and actors.

conditions.purpose: Normalized predicates that can be evaluated by server-side player, actor, world, and encounter state.

quest_effects.purpose: Normalized server-readable quest and dialogue effects derived from legacy result scripts.

legacy_effects.purpose: Imported MWScript result blocks held as migration targets until they are converted into server-safe effects.

playerQuestState.storage: append-only events plus compacted per-player view

worldQuestState.storage: shared events keyed by questId and explicit scope

transactions.dialogue: server lease before selecting a response with effects
transactions.quest: compare-and-swap on current step and quest epoch
transactions.inventory: quest effects must commit with item/container transactions
